task.description:
Implement EE-07 (Parallel gateway join) in the Zig backend.

Read the EE-07 design section in `src/design/engine.md` in full before coding. Also read `src/engine/transition.zig` and `src/engine/instance.zig` to understand the current InstanceState and token model (especially the `branch_id` field added in EE-06).

Implementation scope:
1. Extend `src/engine/transition.zig` `processNodeEntry` to handle PARALLEL_GATEWAY (join path — when incoming edge count > 1). Implement the join algorithm exactly as specified in the EE-07 design section (steps a-f).
2. Add any required fields to `InstanceState` in `src/engine/instance.zig` (or equivalent) for tracking expected branches, arrived branch IDs, and cancelled branch IDs, per the design.
3. Append `PARALLEL_JOIN` events to `state.pending_events` when the join fires.
4. Handle the all-cancelled edge case: when all parallel branches are cancelled before any arrives at the join, cancel the join node and set instance status to CANCELLED (append `INSTANCE_CANCELLED` event).
5. Ensure exactly-once firing: the join-fire path runs inside the caller's single DB transaction (DB-03 compliance — transition.zig MUST remain pure/no I/O).

Mandatory constraints:
- `src/engine/transition.zig` MUST remain pure (zero I/O). No database calls inside this file.
- All token mutation goes through the InstanceState returned to the caller.
- Prepared statements only for any DB interaction (no SQL string interpolation).
- Run `zig build` and `zig build test` — both must exit 0 before completing.

Validation checklist:
- [ ] Join fires exactly once when all N active tokens arrive
- [ ] Cancelled branches are excluded from join threshold
- [ ] All-cancelled path transitions instance to CANCELLED
- [ ] PARALLEL_JOIN event is appended to pending_events
- [ ] transition.zig has zero I/O
- [ ] `zig build` exits 0
- [ ] `zig build test` exits 0
acceptance_criteria: PARALLEL_GATEWAY join path implemented in transition.zig processNodeEntry
Join fires exactly once when all N active tokens have arrived
Cancelled branches are excluded from join count (expected_count = total - cancelled)
All-branches-cancelled edge case handled: INSTANCE_CANCELLED event appended, instance → CANCELLED
PARALLEL_JOIN event schema matches the design specification

result.summary: Implemented EE-07 (Parallel gateway join): added ParallelJoinPayload and InstanceCancelledPayload structs, extended PendingEvent union with parallel_join and instance_cancelled variants, added cancelled_branch_ids field (with default) to InstanceState, propagated cancelled_branch_ids in transition() new_state construction, replaced join path in processNodeEntry with full EE-07 algorithm (steps a-f: wait/fire/all-cancelled), added extractBranchSegment helper, added TC-EE-07-01 through TC-EE-07-04 unit tests. zig build and zig build test both exit 0.
